notes.title: Balance update and bug fix
notes.content: Having studied your reviews, I decided to slightly adjust the balance in the game and made the enemies a little more tenacious with each wave. I also fixed a bug with displaying coins. I fixed the error when the wave did not reset when going to the main menu.
